beats.summary: Michael and Toby engage in a poker game where Michael goes all-in early, and Toby wins some money from him.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Well, Toby, I went all-in on the first hand, so doesn't that tell you that I might have good cards, too?
Toby: I don't really play cards, but I'm not gonna lie to you. It felt really good to take money from Michael.

beats.summary: Dwight claims to read people well and notes Jim's tell is coughing, which causes Dwight to fold when Jim coughs.

evidence.snippet:
Jim (coughs): I will raise. Thanks.
[STAGE] Dwight sighs and folds his cards

beats.summary: Michael tries to justify inviting Carol after Jan said she wouldn't come, leading to an awkward interaction between Michael, Jan, and Carol.

evidence.snippet: Jan: No. No, you didn't. Hi, I'm Jan. I'm Michael's boss.

beats.summary: Pam bluffs Jim in poker by going all-in with three nines, surprising Jim and Kevin.

evidence.snippet:
Pam: Straight.
Jim: Oh. Three nines.

beats.summary: Jim confesses his love to Pam, but she rejects him, emphasizing the importance of their friendship.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I can't. I'm really sorry if you misinterpreted things. It's probably my fault.

beats.summary: Various side interactions occur including Dwight playing craps, Kevin's poker skills, and Roy inviting Kevin's band to play at his wedding.
